applicability: Work Item dashboard-bff-awaiting-confirmation-activity-gap and the dashboard-bff service
condition: The dashboard-bff service does not reintroduce the removed dead USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED event handler; the awaiting-confirmation signal, if surfaced, is sourced only from the DecisionPacket AWAITING_CONFIRMATION status via the existing row CDC.
exception_policy: No automatic exception. A temporary exception requires an explicit authorized, scoped, evidence-linked Waiver; expiry reopens the block.
rationale: This is a condition that must REMAIN true over time (a Guard per DR-0005), distinct from the completion criteria that must BECOME true. Reintroducing the dead event is a regression the effort's whole point was to prevent.
